Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array ... at Mareshah--</hi>one of the towns which Rehoboam fortified (<reference osisRef="2Chr.11.8">2Ch 11:8</reference>), near a great southern pass in the low country of Judah (<reference osisRef="Josh.15.44">Jos 15:44</reference>).
